retraction.reason: Retracted in M44b, class B. Georgia in 2003 argues forward to the Orange revolution of 2004, which this atlas holds and which reaches no Portuguese event at all. The colour revolutions are a cluster here with no way out of themselves; wiring a third record into them would have made the cluster larger and no less stranded.

title: Rose Revolution
